<!-- Generated by npm run docs:automation. Do not edit by hand. -->

共 111 个操作。CLI 和 MCP 共用以下输入结构。异步操作返回任务 ID，通过 `tasks.get` / `tasks.wait` 获取结果；MCP 将结果放在 `structuredContent.result`。

配置对象中 additionalProperties=true 表示支持应用原有高级字段；服务端仍执行对应业务校验。服务商字段请调用 providers.types 查询。

## system.info

Application version, platform, profile, engine runtime paths (e.g. faster-whisper python runtime and binaries), storage topology (userData, storageRoot, temp, logs, models), installed models, hardware environment, providers, and architecture notes.

- CLI：`smartsub system info`
- MCP：`smartsub_system_info`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## system.capabilities

List all operations and whether they are read-only or asynchronous.

- CLI：`smartsub system capabilities`
- MCP：`smartsub_system_capabilities`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## system.logs

Read redacted application logs.

- CLI：`smartsub system logs`
- MCP：`smartsub_system_logs`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "projectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "date": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500,
      "default": 100

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": ["info", "warning", "error"]
      },
      "maxItems": 3,
      "description": "Filter by log level. Use [\"error\", \"warning\"] to diagnose failures quickly."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## tasks.get

Get status, progress, error, result and output paths. Poll until a terminal status.

- CLI：`smartsub tasks get`
- MCP：`smartsub_tasks_get`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": ["id"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## tasks.wait

Wait up to 25 seconds for a terminal or review state. Timeout never cancels a job.

- CLI：`smartsub tasks wait`
- MCP：`smartsub_tasks_wait`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "timeoutMs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 25000,
      "default": 25000
    }
  },
  "required": ["id"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## tasks.cancel

- MCP：`smartsub_tasks_cancel`

```json
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": ["id"],
```

```json
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## tasks.retry

Retry interrupted or failed pipeline files using the saved execution settings.

- CLI：`smartsub tasks retry`
- MCP：`smartsub_tasks_retry`
- 属性：修改/执行；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "requestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "description": "Reuse only to retry the same submission without running it twice."
    }
  },
  "required": ["id"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## transcribe

Generate original-language subtitles using an installed local ASR engine or configured cloud ASR provider. AI segmentation/correction is opt-in and requires config.refineProvider. Inspect settings.get, engines.list, models.list and providers.list before selecting resources. Returns a job ID.

- CLI：`smartsub transcribe`
- MCP：`smartsub_transcribe`
- 属性：修改/执行；异步任务

```json
{

          "enum": ["original", "two-line"]

          "type": "number",
          "minimum": -1

        "subtitleMaxDuration": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0
        },
        "subtitleMaxGap": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "preserveSpeechPauses": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Preserve speech gaps during subtitle segmentation. Does not require an AI provider by itself."
        },
        "aiSegmentation": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in AI semantic segmentation of ASR output. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider; do not enable just to generate original SRT."
        },
        "aiCorrection": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in AI correction of ASR text. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider."
        },
        "refineProvider": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "AI provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"translation\") with isAi=true and configured=true. Required for AI segmentation/correction. Omitted or \"follow-translation\" uses the task translation provider. The in-app assistant can use its current AI service when omitted and no task service resolves. Explicit selections are never replaced."
        },
        "subtitleTranslationStyle": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["neutral", "conversational"],
          "description": "Defaults to neutral. Conversational style requires a configured AI translation provider, including translate-only tasks."
        },
        "speakerDiarization": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in speaker identification for media. Requires installed speaker models and Sherpa runtime; inspect models.list before enabling."
        },
        "speakerDiarizationCount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 8
        },
        "speakerDiarizationEmbedInSubtitle": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "manuscriptPath": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "description": "Task overrides. Optional refinement, speaker identification, dubbing, composition and manuscript inputs are disabled unless explicitly supplied. Engine/model/provider preferences come from settings.get.defaults. Pass the desired task/recipe config here to reuse its advanced stages."
    }
  },
  "required": ["files"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## translate

Translate subtitle files using a configured translation provider and explicit targetLanguage. A missing provider is an error; translation is never silently skipped. Conversational style requires an AI provider. Returns a job ID.

- CLI：`smartsub translate`
- MCP：`smartsub_translate`

```json
          "description": "Cloud ASR provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"asr\"). Requires engine=\"cloud\" and a model in that provider's models list. Independent from translation/refinement/chat."
        },
        "translateProvider": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "Translation provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"translation\"). Required for translate and translating pipelines; \"-1\" is not a valid translation selection."
        },
        "useEmbeddedSubtitles": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "translateContent": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["onlyTranslate", "sourceAndTranslate", "translateAndSource"]
        },
        "subtitleOutputFormats": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": ["srt", "vtt", "ass", "lrc", "txt"]
          },
          "minItems": 1
        },
        "subtitleLayout": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["original", "two-line"]
        },
        "subtitleLineWidth": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0
        },
        "maxSubtitleChars": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": -1
        },
        "subtitleMaxDuration": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0
        },
        "subtitleMaxGap": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "preserveSpeechPauses": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Preserve speech gaps during subtitle segmentation. Does not require an AI provider by itself."
        },
        "aiSegmentation": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in AI semantic segmentation of ASR output. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider; do not enable just to generate original SRT."
        },
        "aiCorrection": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in AI correction of ASR text. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider."
        },
        "refineProvider": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "AI provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"translation\") with isAi=true and configured=true. Required for AI segmentation/correction. Omitted or \"follow-translation\" uses the task translation provider. The in-app assistant can use its current AI service when omitted and no task service resolves. Explicit selections are never replaced."
        },
        "subtitleTranslationStyle": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["neutral", "conversational"],
          "description": "Defaults to neutral. Conversational style requires a configured AI translation provider, including translate-only tasks."
        },
        "speakerDiarization": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Opt-in speaker identification for media. Requires installed speaker models and Sherpa runtime; inspect models.list before enabling."
        },
        "speakerDiarizationCount": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 8
        },
        "speakerDiarizationEmbedInSubtitle": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "manuscriptPath": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "description": "Task overrides. Optional refinement, speaker identification, dubbing, composition and manuscript inputs are disabled unless explicitly supplied. Engine/model/provider preferences come from settings.get.defaults. Pass the desired task/recipe config here to reuse its advanced stages."
    }
  },
  "required": ["files", "targetLanguage"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## subtitles.read

Read subtitle cues with a content version for safe editing. Paginated; times are milliseconds.

- CLI：`smartsub subtitles read`
- MCP：`smartsub_subtitles_read`
- 属性：读取；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filePath": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
    },
    "offset": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "default": 0
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500,
      "default": 100
    }
  },
  "required": ["filePath"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## subtitles.write

Write subtitle cues to a new file. In-place changes require overwrite=true and the version returned by subtitles.read.

- 属性：修改/执行；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",

      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",

          "startMs": {
            "type": "number",
            "minimum": 0
          },
          "endMs": {
            "type": "number",
            "minimum": 0
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": ["startMs", "endMs", "text"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },

      "enum": ["srt", "vtt", "ass", "lrc", "txt"]

      "default": false
    },
    "expectedVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    }
  },
  "required": ["filePath", "cues"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## compose.run

Burn or mux subtitles into video. config uses MergeConfig: outputMode hardcode/softmux, style, videoQuality, encoderMode and optional audioTrack.

- CLI：`smartsub compose run`
- MCP：`smartsub_compose_run`
- 属性：修改/执行；异步任务

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "videoPath": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
    },
    "subtitlePath": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
    },
    "outputPath": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
    },
    "config": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "outputMode": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["hardcode", "softmux"],
          "default": "hardcode"
        },
        "videoQuality": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["original", "high", "standard"]
        },
        "encoderMode": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["cpu", "hardware"]
        },
        "style": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "fontName": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "fontSize": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 10,
              "maximum": 72
            },
            "primaryColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "outlineColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "backColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "backOpacity": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 100
            },
            "bold": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "italic": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "underline": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "borderStyle": {
              "type": "number",
              "enum": [1, 3]
            },
            "outline": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 10
            },
            "shadow": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 10
            },
            "alignment": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 9
            },
            "marginL": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "marginR": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "marginV": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "positionY": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 100
            },
            "secondLineColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "highlightTerms": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              }
            },
            "highlightColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            },
            "glow": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "glowColor": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "audioTrack": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "mode": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": ["replace", "mix", "addTrack"]
            },
            "trackPath": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
            },
            "duckRatio": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0
            }
          },
          "required": ["mode", "trackPath"],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "default": {}
    },
    "requestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "description": "Reuse only to retry the same submission without running it twice."
    }
  },
  "required": ["videoPath", "subtitlePath"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

## dubbing.run

Synthesize all or stale subtitle cues. config uses DubbingConfig.

- CLI：`smartsub dubbing run`
- MCP：`smartsub_dubbing_run`
- 属性：修改/执行；异步任务

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "config": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "engine": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "kind": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "local"
                },
                "modelId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                }
              },
              "required": ["kind", "modelId"],
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "kind": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "const": "cloud"
                },
                "providerId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                }
              },
              "required": ["kind", "providerId"],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          ]
        },
        "voice": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "language": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "globalSpeed": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0.5,
          "maximum": 2,
          "default": 1
        },
        "cloneQuality": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["standard", "high"]
        },
        "localConcurrency": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 3
        },
        "overflow": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["truncate", "shift"]
        },
        "overlapMode": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["shift", "mix"]
        },
        "background": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["mute", "duck"],
          "default": "mute"
        },
        "output": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["audioOnly", "replaceTrack", "mixTrack", "addTrack"],
          "default": "audioOnly"
        },
        "audioFormat": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["wav", "mp3"]
        },
        "exportShiftedSubtitle": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": ["engine", "voice"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "force": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "staleOnly": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "speakerId": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "requestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "description": "Reuse only to retry the same submission without running it twice."
    }
  },
  "required": ["sessionId", "config"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```

```json
            "cloudUploadConsent": {

  },

}
```

## recipes.save

Save a workflow recipe: name,goals,accepts,config.

- CLI：`smartsub recipes save`
- MCP：`smartsub_recipes_save`
- 属性：修改/执行；直接返回

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "recipe": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "goals": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "translate": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "dub": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "video": {
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          },
          "required": ["translate", "dub", "video"],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "accepts": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["media", "subtitle"]
        },
        "config": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "dub": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "engine": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "kind": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "const": "local"
                        },
                        "modelId": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "minLength": 1
                        }
                      },
                      "required": ["kind", "modelId"],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "kind": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "const": "cloud"
                        },
                        "providerId": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "minLength": 1
                        }
                      },
                      "required": ["kind", "providerId"],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "voice": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                },
                "language": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                },
                "globalSpeed": {
                  "type": "number",
                  "minimum": 0.5,
                  "maximum": 2,
                  "default": 1
                },
                "cloneQuality": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["standard", "high"]
                },
                "localConcurrency": {
                  "type": "integer",
                  "minimum": 1,
                  "maximum": 3
                },
                "overflow": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["truncate", "shift"]
                },
                "overlapMode": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["shift", "mix"]
                }
              },
              "required": ["engine", "voice"],
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "description": "Opt-in dubbing. Use models.list for local TTS or providers.list(kind=\"tts\") for cloud; choose a compatible voice with tts.voices or voices.list. Chat and ASR services cannot provide TTS."
            },
            "compose": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "subtitle": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["hard", "soft", "none"]
                },
                "style": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "fontName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "fontSize": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 10,
                      "maximum": 72
                    },
                    "primaryColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "outlineColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "backColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "backOpacity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 100
                    },
                    "bold": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "italic": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "underline": {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "borderStyle": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "enum": [1, 3]
                    },
                    "outline": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 10
                    },
                    "shadow": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 10
                    },
                    "alignment": {
                      "type": "integer",
                      "minimum": 1,
                      "maximum": 9
                    },
                    "marginL": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0
                    },
                    "marginR": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0
                    },
                    "marginV": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0
                    },
                    "positionY": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 100
                    },
                    "secondLineColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "highlightTerms": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "minLength": 1
                      }
                    },
                    "highlightColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    },
                    "glow": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "minimum": 0
                    },
                    "glowColor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "additionalProperties": true
                },
                "styleId": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                },
                "styleName": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1
                },
                "videoQuality": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["original", "high", "standard"]
                },
                "encoderMode": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["cpu", "hardware"]
                }
              },
              "required": ["subtitle"],
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "gates": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "subtitle": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["auto", "manual"],
                  "default": "auto"
                },
                "dubbing": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": ["auto", "manual"],
                  "default": "auto"
                }
              },
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "asrProviderId": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Cloud ASR provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"asr\"). Requires engine=\"cloud\" and a model in that provider's models list. Independent from translation/refinement/chat."
            },
            "translateProvider": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Translation provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"translation\"). Required for translate and translating pipelines; \"-1\" is not a valid translation selection."
            },
            "useEmbeddedSubtitles": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "translateContent": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "onlyTranslate",
                "sourceAndTranslate",
                "translateAndSource"
              ]
            },
            "subtitleOutputFormats": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["srt", "vtt", "ass", "lrc", "txt"]
              },
              "minItems": 1
            },
            "subtitleLayout": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": ["original", "two-line"]
            },
            "subtitleLineWidth": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0
            },
            "maxSubtitleChars": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": -1
            },
            "subtitleMaxDuration": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0
            },
            "subtitleMaxGap": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "preserveSpeechPauses": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "description": "Preserve speech gaps during subtitle segmentation. Does not require an AI provider by itself."
            },
            "aiSegmentation": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "description": "Opt-in AI semantic segmentation of ASR output. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider; do not enable just to generate original SRT."
            },
            "aiCorrection": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "description": "Opt-in AI correction of ASR text. Defaults to false for automation. Requires a configured AI refineProvider."
            },
            "refineProvider": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "AI provider ID from providers.list(kind=\"translation\") with isAi=true and configured=true. Required for AI segmentation/correction. Omitted or \"follow-translation\" uses the task translation provider. The in-app assistant can use its current AI service when omitted and no task service resolves. Explicit selections are never replaced."
            },
            "subtitleTranslationStyle": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": ["neutral", "conversational"],
              "description": "Defaults to neutral. Conversational style requires a configured AI translation provider, including translate-only tasks."
            },
            "speakerDiarization": {
              "type": "boolean",
              "description": "Opt-in speaker identification for media. Requires installed speaker models and Sherpa runtime; inspect models.list before enabling."
            },
            "speakerDiarizationCount": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 8
            },
            "speakerDiarizationEmbedInSubtitle": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "manuscriptPath": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Absolute local file or directory path on the SmartSub host."
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": true,
          "description": "Task overrides. Optional AI refinement, speaker identification, dubbing, composition and manuscript inputs are disabled unless supplied here. Engine/model/provider preferences are inherited from settings.get.defaults. Further IFormData fields are accepted for compatibility; see types/types.ts."
        }
      },
      "required": ["name", "goals", "accepts"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": ["recipe"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
}
```
